Specification: A module containing formal TLA+ proofs for fundamental graph reachability lemmas. It establishes properties such as node inclusion in reachable sets, reachability across set unions, and state transitions involving successor nodes using mathematical induction and structured proof steps.
AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes,
                      NEW n \in S PROVE  n \in ReachableFrom(S)
    OBVIOUS
  
  
  
  
  <1>1. ExistsPath(n,n)
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    <2> USE DEF ExistsPath, IsPathFromTo
    <2> WITNESS <<n>> \in Seq(Nodes)
    <2>

ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes, NEW T \in SUBSET Nodes,
                      \A n \in S : Succ[n] \subseteq (S \cup T) PROVE  (S \cup ReachableFrom(T)) = ReachableFrom(S \cup T)
    OBVIOUS
  
  
  
  
  <1>1. (S \cup ReachableFrom(T)) \subseteq ReachableFrom(S \cup T)
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    <2>1. \A n \in S : n \in ReachableFrom(S)
ASSUME NEW n \in ReachableFrom(S) PROVE  n \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)

ASSUME NEW m \in S, NEW q \in Nodes,
                            NEW p \in Seq(Nodes),
                            /\ IsPathFromTo(p,m,q)
                            /\ Len(p) = 0+1 PROVE  q \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)
          OBVIOUS
        <4>

ASSUME NEW i \in Nat, R(i) PROVE  R(i+1)
        
        
        
        <4> SUFFICES ASSUME NEW m \in S, NEW q \in Nodes,
                            NEW p \in Seq(Nodes),
                            /\ IsPathFromTo(p,m,q)
                            /\ Len(p) = (i+1)+1
                     PROVE  q \in S \cup ReachableFrom(T)

ASSUME NEW S \in SUBSET Nodes,
                      NEW n \in S PROVE  /\ ReachableFrom(S) = ReachableFrom(S \cup Succ[n])
                      /\ n \in ReachableFrom(S)
    OBVIOUS
  <1>1. ReachableFrom(S) = ReachableFrom(S \cup Succ[n])
    
    
    
    
    <2>1. ReachableFrom(S) \subseteq ReachableFrom(S \cup Succ[n])

ASSUME NEW m \in Succ[n], NEW o \in Nodes,
                          ExistsPath(m, o) PROVE  ExistsPath(n, o)
